definition: A person identifiable from the media itself, by the depicted person or another person, or from personal information displayed with the media.
Has the meaning provided in Minnesota Statutes section 609.341, subdivision 5.
Alteration or generation of realistic media depicting an intimate part not present in the original media of an identifiable individual.
Substantial application of individualized technological or artistic skill and judgment by a human creator in directing, shaping, or controlling output.
